data.one_liner: Flutter widget to display and interact with tournament brackets.
data.what_it_does: Provides a TournamentBracket widget that visualizes tournaments with matches, scores, and custom team cards. It supports zooming, panning, and styling options for connecting lines.
use_when: You need to display a tournament bracket or playoff tree in your app.
You want support for zooming and panning across matches.
avoid_when: You need a generic charting library for graphs or analytics.
You need built-in state management for generating and updating tournament match schedules.
strengths: Includes support for zooming and panning out of the box.
Highly customizable match cards and connecting line styles.
weaknesses: Limited to visual display and lacks built-in tournament generation or bracket logic.
Not documented for platform-specific edge cases beyond standard Flutter rendering.
data.minimal_example:
TournamentBracket(
  list: _tournaments,
  card: (item) => customMatchCard(item),
  cardWidth: 220.0,
  cardHeight: 100,
)
